To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the use of organic insecticides, fungicides, growth regulators and foliar fertilizers in combination with each other and with synthetic insecticides, fungicide and growth regulators can increase the productivity and protect field pea organic cultivation from the pea weevil.

organic cultivation of field pea with use of products with various actions (NeemAzal T / S and Pyrethrin FS-EC, as insecticides, Biofa and Polyversum, as foliar fertilizers and growth regulators, respectively), applied in combination or alone, is an efficient alternative to conventional synthetic insecticides, fungicides and fertilizers.
organic products, applied individually or in combination with Polyverseum or Biofa, are able to increase productivity of pea organic farming, as well as control the pea weevil.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new, environmentally safe and effective methods for the control of the pea-weevil, which are important for organic cultivation of field pea.
a new direction in organic farming, which is to use combinations of organic products with different action, as well as with the development of a new strategy for control of pea weevil in field pea.
the possibilities for increasing productivity and control of pea weevil in field pea organic cultivation by the application of organic products.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the application of the tested products in pea organic farming is promising.

the use of the organic mixtures Biofa+Pytrethrum and Polyversum+Pytrethrm, applied twice, at budding and flowering stage, is the most promising and effective method for the protection against pea weevils and for obtaining high yield of organic pea.
organic cultivation of pea by the use of products with insecticidal, fungicidal and plant growth regulatory activity is possible.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
there is a possibility for increasing the productivity of field pea in organic farming conditions, as well as to reduce the damage from pea weevil by the use of organic bioproducts.
the organic products used are effective and stable and they can be recommended for use in organic pea cultivation.
organic cultivation of field pea is possible and the use of bioproducts is a promising direction for the control of pea weevil.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of organic products in field pea cultivation is a perspective way of increasing productivity and control of pea weevil in organic farming.
it is possible to increase pea productivity by the use of organic products.
